Inspection Procedure O-20: Sunroof switch: The open, close/tilt-down, or tilt-up switch signal is not 
sent to the ETACS-ECU.
CIRCUIT OPERATION
The ETACS-ECU receives a signal from the sunroof 
switch through the sunroof motor assembly, and 
sends the input signal to the data link connector.
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
If the SWS communication line between the sunroof 
motor assembly and the ETACS-ECU is defective, 
the sunroof switch input signal can not be checked 
even if the sunroof is normal.
